description: Make the interior Kitchen room description distinguish a shattered Kitchen window from an ordinarily open sash

replacements.new:
<COND (<MATERIAL-DESTRUCTION-GET ,MD-WINDOW-BROKEN>
		      <TELL "shattered out; jagged remnants frame an opening large enough to use." CR>)
		     (<FSET? ,KITCHEN-WINDOW ,OPENBIT>
		      <TELL "open." CR>)
		     (T
		      <TELL "slightly ajar." CR>)>
